verification.near_duplicate_assessment: The 48 warnings are a data-quality signal, not validate bugs. Most are distinct shop landmarks on the same street (for example 7_eleven_hau vs southstar_drugstore_near_hau, 10 m). The closest pairs (4-11 m) are mostly across different routes in the shared Purple/Grey/Yellow corridor, e.g. puregold (yellow_out) vs villarica (grey_out) 7 m, osave (grey) vs ronnie_battery_center_near_osave (purple) 9 m, balibago_fresh_options (grey) vs icare_wellness (purple) 5 m. These are probably the same physical boarding spot named differently by route, so no shared stop_id and no transfer node between them. Plausible as a hand-traced artifact; the maintainer should review before trusting transfers. Not suppressed, not a spec violation. Display quirk: a pair at 29.6 m prints "only 30 m apart (under 30 m)" because of rounding.

bug.description: Seed with unreachable DB prints several multi-line psycopg_pool "error connecting in pool-1" log blocks before the final clear "seed: database unreachable, nothing written" line. No traceback and rc=1, but criterion 23 asks for a one-line message; cosmetic.
Warning text rounds distances: "only 30 m apart (under 30 m)" is printed for pairs whose true distance is just below 30 m (e.g. balibago_cebuana_lhuillier / balibago_pc_logic). Looks contradictory.
